Liam / Neha — thanks. Proposing the following commercial structure so legal can review and procurement can confirm:

- Pricing schedule: commit-based tiering: Q2 100k tokens @ $0.0025/token, Q3 200k @ $0.0022/token, Q4 400k @ $0.0020/token. Any overage billed at the Q4 rate.
- Minimum commit waterfall & invoicing: Redwood invoices at the start of each quarter for that quarter's committed tokens. Activation month is prorated to the start-of-quarter invoice. If activation lands mid-quarter, we prorate based on days remaining.
- Net terms: Net 45 standard. For net 60 request, we can add a 2% surcharge on invoices or extend with a 30-day credit approval, whichever you prefer.
- Taxes: Invoices will show VAT where applicable; withholding remains the customer's responsibility unless we agree to a gross-up.

If procurement confirms billing to Acme Robotics, Inc. (US) and provides W-9, we can finalize and Ben will sign commercial approval. Kimberly — please add anything material for legal.

Hi all — legal here with a short redlines summary after reviewing ACME_OrderForm_v3.pdf and Neha's notes. Key edits we are proposing: 

1) Invoicing/Entity clause: Insert explicit "invoice recipient" field on the Order Form and require supporting tax documentation (W-9 or local VAT reg certificate) prior to initial invoice. This prevents cross-entity disputes.
2) Net terms and late fees: Standardize Net 45 on the Order Form. If Customer requires Net 60, add a contract appendix that documents the commercial concession and a 2% servicing fee for extension.
3) Taxes and withholding: Add an express clause that Customer is responsible for taxes and any withholding unless otherwise agreed in writing; Redwood may require gross-up if withholding reduces payment below the invoiced amount.
4) Minimum commitment & proration: Clarify that committed tokens are invoiced in advance and any unused committed tokens do not automatically roll; propose a limited carry-forward (up to one quarter) for usage underruns only with written consent.
5) Escrow/credit: If Acme requests escrow for funds, require a negotiated escrow agreement and Redwood's standard escrow terms to be included as an addendum.

I have attached a marked-up PDF and a short "redline summary" doc (legal_redlines_ACME.pdf). Please confirm billing entity and provide W-9 by EOD Friday so we can issue the updated DocuSign envelope.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
